exact_oracle.scope: Finite-state endpoint admission cardinality and schedule consistency; the AI completion guard correction is outside this endpoint-only oracle.

statistical_evidence_hierarchy.formula: p_u <= 1 - alpha^(1/N_u) for zero failures under the stated IID unit
statistical_evidence_hierarchy.interpretation: The four units are alternative IID assumptions, not four simultaneous guarantees. Node-level evidence is only two A100 nodes and remains statistically weak; no result is WCET or cross-family evidence.
statistical_evidence_hierarchy.reporting_rule: Use the coarsest defensible independent unit for the target population; do not promote TB-level sensitivity to WCET or hardware-population reliability.

remaining_qualification_gaps: production DU/FAPI d_MAC trace and same-clock timing contract
defensible service-bound/WCET methodology beyond finite samples
broker restart and durable ambiguous-token reconciliation
shared mandatory recovery or non-separable multi-home certificate
claim_boundary: V12 predicts and C135/C136 realize one synthetic two-home A100/MPS conditional AI40 class whose complete 57 ms transaction is outside static 53 ms slack and inside a 58 ms conditional window. Evidence is two-node same-family finite-sample mechanism requalification, not throughput superiority, WCET, production d_MAC, cross-family reliability, restart, durable reconciliation, or exactly-once evidence.
